summary.proxyDown: Proxy itself is down — even overseas is unreachable.
summary.rulesEmpty: Routing rule-sets failed to load — domestic & local traffic falls through to the proxy.
summary.ruleSourceBlockedOldConfig: Rule source unreachable and config has no local fallback — domestic / 127 are at risk.
summary.oldConfig: Subscription is an old version without local fallback.
summary.domesticFail: Config looks fine but domestic is unreachable.
summary.exitMismatch: Exit IP differs from your assigned exit.

advice.proxyDown: Check the exit / TUN, or use One-click Stop CV on the account card, then retry.
advice.resyncOnly: Re-sync the subscription to pull the latest config, then retry.
advice.ruleSourceBlocked: Rule source is blocked. Re-sync to get the new config (it adds local fallback so domestic/127 stay direct).
advice.exitMismatch: TUN may not be active or is preempted. Restart the core / stop conflicting Clash Verge, then retry.

status.systemProxyEnabled: System proxy is enabled, your applications will access the network through the proxy
status.systemProxyDisabled: System proxy is disabled, it is recommended for most users to turn on this option
status.tunModeServiceRequired: TUN mode requires service mode, please install the service first
status.tunModeEnabled: TUN mode is enabled, applications will access the network through the virtual network card
status.tunModeDisabled: TUN mode is disabled, suitable for special applications

tooltips.systemProxy: Системалы прокси көйләүләрен үзгәртү рөхсәтен бирегез. Әгәр рөхсәт алу мөмкин түгел икән, прокси көйләүләрен кулдан үзгәртегез
tooltips.tunMode: TUN mode can take over all application traffic, suitable for special applications that do not follow the system proxy settings

exitCheck.mismatch: Current exit IP ({{actual}}) differs from your assigned exit ({{expected}}). The proxy may not be connected or traffic is leaving through the wrong exit. Please check your connection.

descriptions.rule: Automatically choose proxies according to the rule set.
descriptions.global: Forward all network requests through the selected proxy.
descriptions.direct: Bypass the proxy and connect to the internet directly.
